attacks.name: Poisoned Blade
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|*Poison|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§poison§Poison| special condition.
|!wild| |*Elusive|: After this attack is resolved, this character may Advance |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Assassin‘s Pistol
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!hit| |*Pursuit|: After this attack is resolved, this character may Advance Toward the defender |!movement_small|.
|!wild| |*Stun|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.

attacks.name: Viper Strike
steps: If the defender has the |§poison§Poison| special condition, this character may reroll up to 2 of its attack dice.
After this attack is resolved, Place this character within |!range| 1 of the defender.
|!wild| |*Venom|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§slow§Slow| and |§stun§Stun| special conditions.

superPowers.name: Displacement Ring
superPowers.body: Place this character within |!range| 2 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Coiled Serpent
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by an attack within |!range| 2, it may use this superpower. Instead of rolling dice equal to its Defense, it rolls 5 defense dice. Then, after the attack is resolved, if this character suffered no |!damage| from the attack, the attacker suffers 2 |!damage|.

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 5 to 6 on Healthy side.
"Poisoned Blade" Poison special rule does not require a |!wild| trigger anymore.
Viper Strike gained a new special rule allowing this character to reroll up to 2 attack dice if the defender has the Poison special condition.
